title: Off-by-one error in range boundary: `range(len(readings) - self.window_size)` produces indices 0 through N-W-1, but the
description: Off-by-one error in range boundary: `range(len(readings) - self.window_size)` produces indices 0 through N-W-1, but the correct range is 0 through N-W (inclusive). The docstring states this should return N - W + 1 values, but it returns N - W values instead, silently dropping the last valid window. Use `range(len(readings) - self.window_size + 1)` to include the final window position.
